scenes.text: Learn to compare graphs in which the same data has been displayed and explain how they are the same and different and find examples of graphs in which many-to-one correspondence is used in print and electronic media, such as newspapers, magazines and the internet, and describe the correspondence used
A table lists orange: 26 and banana: 8. How many more are in the larger group? The answer is 18. Subtract the smaller bar height from the larger.
A bar chart shows mangoes: 24 and bananas: 11. What is the difference between their bars? Pause and solve it in your exercise book.
The answer is 13. Subtract the smaller count.
